notes.title: One of the best puzzle games on Steam just got its first update in 11 years and is also verified for Steam Deck: 'We couldn't resist including some visual, aural, and input adjustments'
notes.notes: Have you played The Swapper? If not, you should swap whatever you're doing right now for playing The Swapper. Originally released back in 2013, it's a sci-fi puzzler that hinges on your ability to create clones of yourself, which then mimic your every movement. From this simple concept, The Swapper produces some delightfully brain-tangling puzzles, and a story that probes the question of personal identity with discomforting acuity. Oh, and it's all wrapped in eerie, Claymation-based art that still looks beautiful today... Read more.

notes.title: Maintenance update out now!
notes.notes:
[i][b]<<< BEGIN INCOMING TRANSMISSION >>>[/b][/i]

Survey expedition reporting again. The maintenance update is now available for all players. The original purpose of this release was addressing bit rot that had accumulated over the years, but we couldn't resist including some visual, aural and input adjustments that make the game feel a little bit smoother. The visual improvements can be toggled on/off in the options menu under Bump map anti-aliasing, Enhanced edges, Vignette and Dithering.

While these changes are subtle enough that they could go unnoticed if you're not looking for them, we've created a Legacy branch for those of you who want to play the game like it's 2013 again. It includes only essential fixes that affect game stability and compatibility.

We're also happy to report that the game seems to run just fine on Steam Deck. [strike]We hope it will be reviewed for official compatibility soon[/strike]. EDIT: The game has now been verified for Steam Deck. The main branch is recommended when playing handheld because the visual stability improvements have a more noticeable effect on smaller resolutions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4769456/51252af159be67481e511eb04a8ca22cd476e64e.jpg[/img]
[b]*** CHANGELOG ***[/b]
- Gfx - Added Dithering (removes banding in gradients, overlays and light effects)
- Gfx - Added Enhanced edges (makes edges more stable when Depth of Field is on)
- Gfx - Updated textures to reduce edge flickering
- Gfx - Added Bump map anti-aliasing (improves stability of specular highlights)
- Gfx - Minor changes to rendering to improve edge stability
- Gfx - Added Enhanced vignette and an option for turning vignette off
- Active display resolution is selected when game is started for the first time
- Small adjustments to options menu layout
- Audio - more natural sound panning
- Audio - made text log character appear blip slightly louder
- HiDPI visual matrix (display system) compatibility
- More future-proof windowing implementation
- Updated Steamworks SDK artefact and Big Picture keyboard overlay
- FIX - Company logo fade at game start jumped abruptly
- FIX - Loading bar stopped for a while at the end of loading screen
- FIX - Audio - player-centric sounds, like footsteps were sometimes panned to the side
- FIX - Audio - text log character appear blip didn't always play
- FIX - Input - cursor stutter due to a thread synchronization issue in cursor latency minimization code
- FIX - Input anomaly - cursor immobilization (cursor cannot be moved)
- FIX - Hidden terminal access causing catastrophic failure
- FIX - Possible instability in the audio subsystem
- FIX - Slight darkening on screen edge (from blur shader)
- FIX - Typo in a subtitle

[b]*** CHANGELOG (LEGACY BRANCH) ***[/b]
- HiDPI visual matrix (display system) compatibility
- More future-proof windowing implementation
- Updated Steamworks SDK artefact and Big Picture keyboard overlay
- FIX - Input anomaly - cursor immobilization (cursor cannot be moved)
- FIX - Hidden terminal access causing catastrophic failure
- FIX - Possible instability in the audio subsystem
- FIX - Typo in a subtitle

[b]*** LEGACY BRANCH ACCESS PROTOCOL ***[/b]
- Restart the Steam client if it's currently running
- Right click on The Swapper in the Steam library. Click properties.
- Select the Betas tab
- Select [i]legacy[/i] from the Beta Participation dropdown
- Initiate patch sequence and confirm update completion

[b]*** ADDENDUM ***[/b]
- Please relay anomaly and instability reports via designated comment frequency or support@facepalmgames.com (please include your system information e.g. operating system version, GPU & display model, and GPU driver version).

[i][b]<<< END TRANSMISSION >>>[/b][/i]

notes.title: Noita coming to Early Access on September 24th!
notes.notes:
Some of you have been wondering if there's ever going to be another game from the developers of The Swapper. A new game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881100/Noita/]Noita[/url], by bunch of friends and me (Olli), is launching in Early Access in less than a month:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/881100/Noita/

Noita has been a a ton of fun to work on. The game's pixel based physics and chemistry simulations still provide fresh gameplay after over six years of development.

Without further ado, here's the early access launch date trailer for Noita:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=smkdscv6SJs

notes.title: Have You Played The Swapper?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

When you play the game of clones, you win or you die. Or both.

The Swapper is a 2D platformer that asks metaphysical questions about the intersection between consciousness, survival, and identity. I like it quite a lot.

notes.title: The Swapper deploying clones to PS4, PS3 and Vita
notes.notes: As befits a game about cloning yourself, The Swapper is multiplying onto PlayStation 4, PS3, and Vita. Facepalm Games' sci-fi puzzle-platformer is fizzing away in Sony test tubes at Curve Studios, the folks behind PlayStation ports of PC games from Proteus to Thomas Was Alone.

notes.title: What s Yours Is Charity s: Humble Indie Bundle 11
notes.notes:
Another Humble Indie Bundle? What a strange turn of events. I thought for sure that Humble was going to suddenly and inexplicably shut down their massively successful enterprise this time around. I mean, they’re on Humble Indie Bundle 11 now. What a gross number. Ten – nay, X – was so svelte, so confident. It plucked the olive from life’s martini glass just so, and we all just wanted its gaze to fall on us for a single precious second. So seriously, what’s even the point of having more Humble Bundles? Oh, right: amazing games and charity and stuff. This time around, the star-studded lineup includes Guacamelee, Monaco, Antichamber, and my personal favorite puzzler of 2013, The Swapper.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Linux + OS X support, compatibility fixes!
notes.notes:
We've just released an update that we decided to call v1.16.
It adds and contains, amongst other boring techy things:
[list]
[*] [b]Linux support![/b]
[*] [b]OSX support![/b]
[*] SDL2 as platform abstraction library instead of OpenTK, fixes multiple compatibility issues
[*] GPU-scaled fullscreen mode, the game never changes screen resolution anymore
[*] Updated FMOD audio library to version 4.44.30, fixes audio related crashes
[*] The game doesn't use XML serializers anymore, fixes an extremely rare crash issue
[*] Improved debug logging
[*] Made gamepad support more robust
[*] Got rid of GLU requirement
[*] Multiple minor compatibility fixes
[/list]

Linux and OS X versions will be available for download also for people who bought the game before the update!

notes.title: Humble Indie Bundle 11 includes Guacamelee, Antichamber, and Monaco
notes.notes: Humble Bundle is stepping into the ring with a new batch of indie games. The Humble Indie Bundle 11 includes up to six games, depending on how much you choose to play, including Drinkbox Games' lucha libre Metrovania beat-'em-up, Guacamelee! Gold Edition, the Escher-esque first-person puzzler Antichamber, and the manic heist game Monaco: What's Yours Is Mine. And of course, you can choose how much of your money goes to developers or the Child's Play and Electronic Frontier Foundation charities.

notes.title: Gamepad + Big Picture mode update is out!
notes.notes:
Now you can explore the dark mysteries of Theseus from the comfort of your sofa!

As the title says this update adds native gamepad support to The Swapper. We've put a big effort into making playing with gamepad feel natural by adding snapping support to the map and reworking all menu controls. The game also supports rumble on some controllers.

The update should be automatically downloaded by Steam. If that doesn't happen a Steam client restart should fix the problem.

notes.title: Humble Bundle opens permanent Humble Store for charity
notes.notes: Humble Bundle is best-known for its pay-what-you-want bundles, but has now launched something a little less fleeting: the Humble Store. The permanent storefront will sell games for Android as well as PC, Mac, and Linux. It all kicks off with a sale on nine games, including Don't Starve, Gunpoint, and Rogue Legacy.

notes.title: Wot I Think: The Swapper
notes.notes:
What would you do if you had a small army of identical, perfectly obedient clones? It’s a question I think we’ve all asked ourselves at least once (usually at around age six) but never really contemplated the ramifications of. Facepalm Games’ The Swapper dives deep into that particular rabbit hole, emerging with a wriggling handful of ethical quandaries and some positively brain-busting puzzles. But does it manage to balance its weighty concept with an equally scale-tipping amount of, you know, fun? Here’s wot I think.

notes.title: Now Available - The Swapper
notes.notes:
The Swapper is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off

Holder of numerous awards and accolades, the Swapper is an atmospheric puzzle platformer set in the furthest reaches of space. Players wield an experimental device able to clone the user and swap control between them. Dropped into a character and world as mysterious as the workings of the device itself, The Swapper is a game of exploration of a very personal nature.
